text:
emily: Quick creative request for next week's launch push  need assets by Wed 11:59am PT: 1) benchmark hero (1200x600) with two editable headline slots, 2) webinar signup modal (480x320) for our docs and blog, 3) animated social short (9:16, 20	6s) for Reels/Stories. Keep strictly on-brand and accessible. cc @rory @jay

rory: Got it. Can you confirm primary messaging and the alternate? Also are we doing JP localization?

emily: Primary: "Predictable inference, ready for production." Alternate: "Ship AI features faster with lower unit cost." JP localization: yes, only hero headline + modal labels.

jay: Agree on localization. Design note: prefer an abstract sparkline (no raw numbers) on the hero and a compact caption: "Representative benchmark across standard production GPUs." No vendor/chip names.

anika: Legal chime: avoid absolute % claims or superlatives. Use "lower" or "reduced" instead of concrete % unless we reference the vetted benchmark asset. I'll block copy once frames are up.

rory: Design questions: 1) CTA color token  is it still #FF3B30? 2) Font weight for CTA? 3) Do we need a high-contrast variant?

emily: CTA = #FF3B30, type = Inter, CTA weight = 600. Yes include an alt high-contrast variant and an accessible export.

brandbot: Brand tokens: primary CTA #FF3B30, bg accent #0F1720, type Inter, motion token = short spring. Provide an accessible variant with 4.5:1 contrast.

jay: For the hero layout, I'll keep the headline in a swap-friendly frame so headlines can be swapped without layout shifts. Modal should include webinar param in the CTA link.

emily: Webinar param: ?webinar=launch2026-05-04. Also need unique UTMs per headline variant for analytics.

rory: UTMs planned: variant A: utm_campaign=launch_may2026&utm_source=social&utm_variant=production_first; variant B: utm_campaign=launch_may2026&utm_source=social&utm_variant=cost_first. Adding webinar query param after utm.

ajay: (typo) jay: I'll add those to the button copy examples so engineers can wire it.

anika: Accessibility: ensure CTA hits 4.5:1 on all hero backgrounds; if using imagery, use a 24% dark overlay. Also alt text for GIF describing motion concisely.

emily: Figma file: https://figma.com/file/redwood-launch-mini-suite. Can someone create frames and drop initial mock by Friday EOD?

rory: I'll mock hero + modal Friday. Jay will produce a GIF prototype Monday AM (ease-in loop, small filesize target).

jay: GIF details: 9:16 vertical, 20s max, subtle sparkline animate + CTA pulse, loop smoothly. I'll export mp4 and optimized gif fallback <2MB if possible.

emily: Legal: @anika will review copy Monday. Also confirm JP translation will be provided by localization team by Tuesday EOD?

anika: Yes I'll review copy Monday morning. Localization: send final english copy by Mon 9am PT and I'll kick JP translation.

brandbot: Frame created: launch_hero_v3 (1200x600), signup_modal_compact_v1 (480x320), social_vertical_v1 (1080x1920). Links dropped in figma.

rory: Uploaded hero v1 + modal v1 to figma and left notes for headline swap. Tagging here when GIF rough is uploaded.

emily: Thanks. Timeline recap: hero + modal mock Fri EOD, copy/legal review Mon, JP localization Tue, final assets Wed 11:59am PT. Please ping here when uploads are ready.

jay: :thumbsup: I'll add an export checklist to the figma file (mp4, gif, web-optimized pngs, alt text).

anika: Noted. I'll watch for the figma link and sign off on copy Monday.

emily: Appreciate it. Reminder: avoid chip/vendor names and absolutes. Keep captions modest.

rory: Added me to figma comment thread for analytics/UTM notes. Link: https://figma.com/comments/launch-abc123

emily: Closing loop  will create the drive folder and share final delivery checklist once files are uploaded. Thanks team!
